header: What the studio puts behind a design job
subheadline: Atlas Studio is employee-owned, so the benefits get decided in the same meeting as the rate card and everyone sees both numbers. These three are what candidates ask about before they sign, so they are the three we publish.

perks.title: Four-day week, full pay
perks.description: The studio closes on Fridays. Client hours dropped to 28 a week in 2023 and the rate card absorbed the difference.

perks.title: EUR 2,000 learning budget
perks.description: Courses, conferences and books, signed off by nobody. Most of it goes on research training and typography.

perks.title: Six weeks working anywhere
perks.description: Work from any timezone within CET plus or minus two hours for six weeks a year, once a project is past discovery.
